referenceSources.title: When Volvo Went Crazy With Its Wagons
referenceSources.description:
Two Volvo 850 Estate touring cars, bearing numbers 15 and 14, thunder down a paved circuit in matching blue-and-white Securicor and Omega Express liveries. The wagons, equipped with Dunlop tires and Volvo-branded windshields, race closely as a crowd of spectators looks on from behind blue-and-white safety barriers.

In 1994, Tom Walkinshaw Racing entered the Volvo 850 Estate in the British Touring Car Championship, leveraging its low center of gravity and five-cylinder engine despite the longer wheelbase. The PR-driven decision to campaign an estate body paid off with a best qualifying result of third and a fifth-place race finish, helping Volvo secure eighth overall in the championship.
